verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static documentation and blog site generator. It has no concept of user-defined automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Its document-versioning CLI versions documentation content, not automations, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
